In continuation to our earlier disclosures dated September 26, 2024 and October 31, 2024 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations ), we hereby inform you that the transaction of divestment of entire stake held by the Company s wholly owned subsidiary, Elgi Compressors USA Inc (Elgi USA), in its Joint Venture Compressed Air Solutions of Texas LLC (CAST), USA, to the joint venture partner has been completed for a total consideration of                  $ 154,586.00 USD.
